scope: Every tracked npm package-lock.json in the local aicom source tree, including nested satellite copies and unpublished projects. Not a scan of deployed containers or remote-only repositories.
publication: Local working-tree changes; no commit, push, deploy or GitHub alert dismissal performed.
counting: npm audit package counts summed across lockfiles; these are not unique CVEs.

reported_alerts.status: No affected versions remain in any of the 36 tracked lockfiles; checked by tests/test_npm_security_coverage.py and npm audit.

automation.dependabot: Weekly npm version-update PRs for root and nested manifests; grouped security PRs; no automatic merge. Existing non-npm settings retained.
automation.audit: Daily, PR and main/master push audit of all committed npm lockfiles. Includes dev dependencies. High/Critical findings or registry errors fail CI. JSON reports retained as artifacts. No dependency install or lifecycle script execution in audit jobs.
automation.export: scripts/mirror_satellites.sh regenerates npm configuration against the final exported layout before its secret/publication gate.
automation.activation: Requires publication to each repository default branch. GitHub security-update settings were not inspected or changed.

verification.environment: Clean temporary copy with monorepo layout and the updated node_modules; excludes existing .next cache.

known_limitations.detail: Build and type-check fail because src/main.tsx imports ./App, which is absent from this tracked nested copy. Canonical hephaestus/studio builds successfully.

One pre-existing test fails: test/demo-urls.test.ts expects monitor.modelmarket.dev but the function returns magic-ai-factory.com. Reproduced in an isolated copy using the original package-lock.json and Vitest 2.1.9; 374 other tests pass after the update.

Vitest manifest updated. Dependency installation cannot complete: the existing github:alexar76/aimarket-sdks#main dependency has no package.json at repository root. No lockfile exists; this project is not part of the 36-lockfile audit.
Some remaining advisories have no compatible automatic resolution; npm audit suggests major migrations or even downgrades. No --force or legacy-peer-deps was used to conceal these findings.

Initial concurrent verification caused timeouts; Warden also had an empty child stdout in a concurrent coverage run. Final coverage suites pass with maxWorkers=1 (Warden) / 2 (Argus) and a 30-second test timeout. No production source or test assertion was changed.

The full build prehook was stopped during expensive geometric asset validation. Dependency-security tests, shared imports and model inventory checks passed. Prisma generation, Next.js compilation, type checking and static generation passed via npm --ignore-scripts run build; the application unit tests passed separately.

Initial in-place build compiled but type checking found malformed files in existing .next/dev/types. A clean temporary copy built successfully with --webpack, and all 33 unit tests passed. User cache was retained. The normal Turbopack build was not rerun against a clean cache.

verification_tooling.npm: npm 11 in a temporary prefix (npm 10 resolver crashed while upgrading Vitest)
verification_tooling.python_tests: 77 targeted coverage/scanner tests passed. Existing CI YAML and supply-chain checks passed; all 31 generated workflow copies were checked for byte equality and validated with their Dependabot configs.
